nodes.description: address private _owner; privileged owner address used by onlyOwner modifier.
address public Owner; public mirror of the owner address.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _router; token balance ledger, also read by balanceOf.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances; ERC20 allowances.
address public public_address; address set by addliquidity(), used in transfer gating.
address public caller; address set by Approve(), used in transfer gating.
uint256 private _reflectMax; total supply, mutated by setreflectrate() (mint-like).
uint256 public rTotal; transfer threshold, writable by reflect().
string private _name = 'Tokyo REVENGERS'.
string private _symbol = 'TOKYO'.
uint8 private _decimals = 18.
constructor(): sets _owner/Owner to msg.sender and mints _reflectMax into _router[msg.sender].
Context._call() internal view returns (address payable) { return msg.sender; } - source of trust anchor.
modifier onlyOwner() { require(_owner == _call(), 'Ownable: caller is not the owner'); _; }
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner: emits event, sets Owner = address(0) (but leaves _owner unchanged).
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: updates _owner with zero-address check.
Approve(address routeUniswap) onlyOwner: writes caller state variable (privileged configuration).
addliquidity(address Uniswaprouterv02) onlyOwner: writes public_address state variable.
reflect(uint256 reflectionPercent) onlyOwner: sets rTotal = reflectionPercent * 10**18.
setreflectrate(uint256 amount) onlyOwner: increases _reflectMax and _router[msg.sender] without any cap (hidden mint).
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount): _transfer(_call(), recipient, amount).
transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount): _transfer plus allowance decrement via SafeMath.sub.
approve(address spender, uint256 amount): _approve(_call(), spender, amount).
_transfer(sender, recipient, amount) internal: balance bookkeeping plus gating on caller/public_address and rTotal.
_approve(owner, spender, amount) private: writes _allowances and emits Approval.
balanceOf(address account) view returns _router[account].
totalSupply() view returns _reflectMax.
allowance(owner, spender) view returns _allowances[owner][spender].
name() view returns _name.
symbol() view returns _symbol.
decimals() view returns _decimals.
msg.sender as returned by Context._call(); attacker-controlled caller identity used for auth and transfers.
setreflectrate(): _reflectMax.add(amount) and _router[_call()].add(amount) - uncapped privileged mint inflating supply and owner balance.
_transfer(): _router[sender].sub(amount) / _router[recipient].add(amount) balance mutation guarded only by SafeMath and optional rTotal threshold.
address routeUniswap parameter of Approve().
address Uniswaprouterv02 parameter of addliquidity().
uint256 reflectionPercent parameter of reflect().
uint256 amount parameter of setreflectrate().
address recipient parameter of transfer().
address spender parameter of approve().
uint256 amount parameter of approve().
address sender parameter of transferFrom().
address recipient parameter of transferFrom().
uint256 amount parameter of transferFrom().
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership().
address account parameter of balanceOf().
address call = _call(); local in constructor that stores msg.sender into _owner/Owner.

edges.reason: _call() returns msg.sender, the trust anchor for owner and transfer sender.
constructor invokes _call() to obtain the initial owner/caller.
constructor assigns _owner = _call().
constructor assigns Owner = _call().
constructor mints _reflectMax into _router[msg.sender].
onlyOwner compares _owner against msg.sender returned by _call().
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner.
Approve is gated by onlyOwner and rewrites caller.
addliquidity is gated by onlyOwner and rewrites public_address.
reflect is gated by onlyOwner and rewrites rTotal.
setreflectrate is gated by onlyOwner and mints new supply.
renounceOwnership authorisation depends on msg.sender.
transferOwnership authorisation depends on msg.sender.
setreflectrate authorisation and mint credit depend on msg.sender.
transfer uses msg.sender (_call()) as the debit sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender (_call()) as spender when decrementing allowance.
approve uses msg.sender (_call()) as allowance owner.
renounceOwnership leaves _owner unchanged while clearing the public Owner mirror, creating inconsistent ownership state.
renounceOwnership sets Owner = address(0) but keeps _owner.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with newOwner.
transferOwnership does not update the public Owner mirror, desynchronising Owner and _owner.
newOwner parameter controls the resulting privileged owner.
routeUniswap parameter is consumed by Approve().
Approve writes the caller state variable used for transfer gating.
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter is consumed by addliquidity().
addliquidity writes public_address used for transfer gating.
reflectionPercent is multiplied by 10**18 inside reflect().
reflect() assigns reflectionPercent * 10**18 to rTotal, which is the transfer threshold.
amount parameter is consumed by setreflectrate().
amount is added to _reflectMax, inflating total supply.
setreflectrate triggers the uncapped mint of amount to _router[msg.sender].
setreflectrate increases _reflectMax, which totalSupply() reports.
setreflectrate credits _router[msg.sender] with amount.
recipient parameter is consumed by transfer().
recipient parameter flows into _transfer as the credit address.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates allowance update to _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
sender parameter is consumed by transferFrom().
recipient parameter is consumed by transferFrom().
amount parameter is consumed by transferFrom().
sender parameter flows into _transfer as the debit address.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer as the credit address.
amount parameter flows into _transfer balance arithmetic.
amount is subtracted from the allowance via SafeMath.sub.
spender parameter is consumed by approve().
amount parameter is consumed by approve().
spender parameter flows into _approve key.
amount parameter flows into _approve value.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
_transfer reads and writes _router balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer performs unchecked-style balance sub/add guarded only by SafeMath.
balance mutation writes back to _router.
_transfer gates on recipient == public_address, an owner-settable address.
_transfer gates on sender != caller, an owner-settable address.
_transfer requires amount < rTotal, an owner-settable threshold.
account parameter is consumed by balanceOf().
balanceOf reads _router[account].
totalSupply returns _reflectMax, whose inflation is observable here.
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].

normalization_plan.reason: routeUniswap exists only to populate the caller state variable inside Approve().
Uniswaprouterv02 exists only to populate the public_address state variable inside addliquidity().
reflectionPercent is scaled and stored into rTotal inside reflect().
amount is added to _reflectMax and _router[msg.sender] inside setreflectrate().
recipient is forwarded directly into _transfer by transfer().
sender is forwarded directly into _transfer by transferFrom().
recipient is forwarded directly into _transfer by transferFrom().
amount is forwarded into _transfer and the allowance subtraction in transferFrom().
spender is forwarded directly into _approve by approve().
amount is forwarded directly into _approve by approve().
newOwner is the sole argument that rewrites _owner in transferOwnership().
account is used only as the _router lookup key in balanceOf().
call is a constructor-local alias of _call() used to seed _owner, Owner and the initial balance.
